title: ThingSpeak Input
text: Read input fields from ThingSpeak channel, 1 output, {Type} sets Data type selector; {Channel number} sets the thingSpeak channel being accessed, {Configure channel parameters} selects and configure channel to access, {ThingSpeak server} sets the server for data transfer, {Channel ID} sets the unique channel, {Read API key} sets the access key for reading from channel character, {Update period (secs)} sets the read update period, in seconds, {View channel web page} sets the access web page for channel, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Channel fields to read} defines which parts of channel to read, {Output data type} defines data type of output, {Mode} sets the method of defining type and {Data type override} sets the policy on a signal type. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Channel number
params.values: ThingSpeak channel being accessed Read-only: 0 (default) | numeric

params.name: Configure channel parameters
params.values: Select and configure channel to access (button)

params.name: ThingSpeak server
params.values: Server for data transfer api.thingspeak.com (default) | character vector

params.name: Read API key
params.values: Access key for reading from channel character vector

params.name: Update period (secs)
params.values: Read update period, in seconds 20 (default) | numeric

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: Send number of missed ticks to port Missed Ticks ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: Yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Channel fields to read
params.values: Define which parts of channel to read 1 (default) | [1–8]

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Define data type of output port double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 |

params.name: Mode
params.values: Method of defining type Built in (default) | Expression

params.name: Type
params.values: Data type selector double (default) | single | int8 | uint8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32

params.name: Data type override
params.values: Policy on a signal type mismatch inherit (default) | off
